outputs.headline: False: 5G towers do not spread coronavirus.
outputs.summary: There is no scientific evidence that 5G mobile networks spread the coronavirus or cause COVID-19.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, leading to an increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G was installed.
outputs.what_is_true: COVID-19 is a viral disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus, which spreads through respiratory droplets. There is no scientific evidence linking the spread of COVID-19 to 5G mobile networks or radio waves.
evidence_against: AP News states there is no scientific evidence linking 5G to COVID-19 spread.
UN News confirms there is no connection between 5G technology and the spread of COVID-19.
The National Center for Biotechnology Information says there is no scientific evidence that 5G spreads the virus or weakens the immune system.
outputs.sources_spoken: AP News, UN News, and the National Center for Biotechnology Information
outputs.audio_script: The post claims that 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, causing cases to rise where 5G was installed. This is false. COVID-19 is a viral disease that spreads through respiratory droplets, and there is no scientific evidence linking its spread to 5G mobile networks or radio waves. We are very sure of this. This information comes from reputable sources like AP News, UN News, and the National Center for Biotechnology Information.
card_lines: False: 5G towers do not spread coronavirus
